import bisect


class CandidateQueryEngine:
    """Bisect-indexed implementation for efficient range queries."""

    def __init__(self, items: dict[int, int] | None = None):
        self._keys: list[int] = []
        self._values: list[int] = []
        if items:
            for key, value in items.items():
                self.put(key, value)

    def put(self, key: int, value: int) -> None:
        key = int(key)
        value = int(value)
        pos = bisect.bisect_left(self._keys, key)
        if pos < len(self._keys) and self._keys[pos] == key:
            self._values[pos] = value
        else:
            self._keys.insert(pos, key)
            self._values.insert(pos, value)

    def delete(self, key: int) -> None:
        key = int(key)
        pos = bisect.bisect_left(self._keys, key)
        if pos < len(self._keys) and self._keys[pos] == key:
            del self._keys[pos]
            del self._values[pos]

    def get(self, key: int) -> int | None:
        key = int(key)
        pos = bisect.bisect_left(self._keys, key)
        if pos < len(self._keys) and self._keys[pos] == key:
            return self._values[pos]
        return None

    def range_sum(self, lo: int, hi: int) -> int:
        lo = int(lo)
        hi = int(hi)
        if lo > hi:
            return 0
        left = bisect.bisect_left(self._keys, lo)
        right = bisect.bisect_right(self._keys, hi)
        return sum(self._values[left:right])

    def aggregate_count(self, lo: int, hi: int) -> int:
        lo = int(lo)
        hi = int(hi)
        if lo > hi:
            return 0
        left = bisect.bisect_left(self._keys, lo)
        right = bisect.bisect_right(self._keys, hi)
        return right - left

    def top_k(self, lo: int, hi: int, k: int) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:
        lo = int(lo)
        hi = int(hi)
        k = int(k)
        if lo > hi or k <= 0:
            return []
        left = bisect.bisect_left(self._keys, lo)
        right = bisect.bisect_right(self._keys, hi)
        rows = [(self._keys[i], self._values[i]) for i in range(left, right)]
        rows.sort(key=lambda item: (-item[1], item[0]))
        return rows[:k]
